publicReleaseNotes: Uptime 0.5.12 adds dedicated mail connection forms and an API transaction step builder, restores monitoring-only console access with write controls hidden, and makes saved check details and monitor erasure receipts easier to read. Exact per-table erasure counts and the original receipt remain in the downloadable receipt. Reviewed Pingdom imports preserve supported SMTP, ping, named DNS servers, certificate-expiry failure windows and slow-response settings; unsupported semantics and private-runner requirements are reported. Named DNS servers use DNS/TCP port 53. A certificate-expiry rule becomes a separate TLS monitor that must be paused or resumed with its HTTP monitor. Independent external health probes no longer inherit a monitor's slow-response rule. Installed PDF reports load their fonts from the installation origin, and monitor documentation follows the current editor and admission policy. Local sign-in explains the private terminal link and invited-person commands; keep that link private. The local command guide documents running JavaScript tools with rer's runtime. Dependency updates include Vite 8.2.4, undici 7.30.1 and transitive Zod 4.6.6. No migration or new required settings; monitors, history, incidents, destinations and private settings are kept on upgrade. The checkout retains its current @runeditrun/rer 0.2.113 pin, replacing 0.2.108 from 0.5.11; update an existing checkout with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile. Known issues: heartbeat output saved by 0.5.6 or earlier is not rewritten, so rotate a key earlier output may have contained; pattern-based redaction can miss an unlabelled secret of no recognizable shape that is not listed under Output text to mask. UptimeRobot monitor CSV import, restoration of the erased-people list, and refusal of an empty company decision feed remain unavailable or unresolved. Response bodies over 64 KiB still fail the check; monitor a smaller health endpoint. Bounded-memory archive restore, operation at 500 monitors with 90 days of history, time-range selection and console chunk-transfer controls remain unestablished or unavailable. Other earlier release limits remain. The product screenshot was taken on 0.4.0, before the console changes of 0.5.0 through 0.5.12.
